༄༅/ /'khor lo sgyur drug gi sgrub thabs phun tshogs thams cad bskyed pa'i gzhi zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'khor lo sgyur drug gi sgrub thabs phun tshogs thams cad bskyed pa'i gzhi zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo badz+ra dha ra ya/ 'khor los sgyur ba drug gi gtso/ /bla ma mchog zhabs la btud nas/ /de yi sgrub thabs rmad byung ba/ /kun la phan phyir bri bar bya/ /'dir 'khor lo sgyur drug gi mngon rtogs bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs sems rdo rje sems pa'i sgo bzlas rnams bya/ shrī he ru ko3haṃ/ rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐/ de las 'od zer dang mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa spros/ bla ma dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs la mchod par gyur/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ / ces sogs sh+lau ka gnyis kyi phyag bya/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyi mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs/ yan lag bdun pa bya/ spro na rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung*/ oṃ muḥ zhes pas gshegs su gsol ba'am mi dmigs par bsam/ tshad med bzhi spy-i dang mthun par bsgom/ mgo bor gzugs phung bh+rūm̐ las rnam snang dkar po g.yas 'khor lo g.yon dril bu dkur bsten nas/ lte bar tshor ba lam̐ las/ rdo rje nyi ma ser po g.yas rin po che/ mgrin par 'du shes hrīḥlas pad+ma gar dbang dmar po g.yas pad+ma/ long bur 'du byed ho las rdo rje rgyal po ljang gu g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje/ gsum ga'ang g.yon dril bu thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ bzhir gar yang phyag g.yas 'phyar ba'i stabs so/ /snying gar rnam shes hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po g.yas rdo rje thugs kar bstod pa/ spyi gtsug tu de bzhin nyid kyi ngo bo nyid las he ru ka nag po g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sa gnon/ de gnyis ni g.yon dril bu dkur bsten pa'o/ /mig tu oṃ las gti mug rdo rje dkar po g.yas 'khor lo/ /rna bar hūm̐ las zhe sdang rdo rje nag po g.yas rdo rje/ snar tram̐ las phrag dog rdo rje ser po g.yas rin po che/ lce rtsar āḥlas 'dod chags rdo rje dmar po g.yas pad+ma/ dpral bar khams las gser sna rdo rje ljang gu g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje/

snyingagar ham̐ las dbang phyug rdo rje dkar po g.yas rdo rje/ gti mug rdo rje phyag g.yon na dkur bsten pa/ zhe sdang rdo rje rdo rje thar 'dzin pa khyad par gzhan rnams kha dog gi rim bzhin rnam snang sogs dang mtshungs pa/ de thams cad kyang ral pa'i cod pan can no/ /lte bar sa khams lam̐ las ltung byed ma ser mo g.yas dang po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ snying gar chu khams lam̐ las gsod byed ma nag mo rdo rje 'dzin pa/ mgrin par me khams pam̐ las 'gugs byed ma dmar mo pad+ma 'dzin pa/ dpral bar rlung khams tam̐ las gar dbang ma ljang khu ral gri 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang g.yas 'og mas gri gug /g.yon gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ gsang gnas su nam mkha'i khams kham̐ dud kha las pad+ma drwa ba can ma dud kha/ dud dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum lcags kyu tshangs mgo gri gug /g.yon gsum thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga zhags pa 'dzin pa/ lha mo lnga skra grol ba lha bcu bdun po thams cad spyan gsum/ phyag rgya lnga ldan/ gcer bu g.yas brkyang gi bzhugs pa'o/ /oṃ kri ti pa ri shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥ pra kri ti pa ri shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs lan gsum/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla re/ mda'i drwa ba/ me ri 'bar ba dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ me dhi ni badz+ri nas/ larka hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes pa'i bar sngags tshan drug brjod/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar/ bh+rūm̐ las bka'i 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa ser po 'khor lo'i lte bar pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐/ de las rang nyid rdo rje sems pa dkar po mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ dkar ser ljang ba'i/ zhal gsum/ rtsa phyag gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang snang gi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ g.yas rkyang gi stabs can de'i thugs ka nas hūm̐ bcu spros te/

'khor lo'i rtsibs bcur 'khod pa khro bo bcur 'khod pa dang*/ bdag nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed hūm̐ mdzad he ru kar gyur pa ni/ sku mdog mthing nag /nag ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas rkyang bas 'jigs byed dus mtshan gnan pa/ shar du rdo rje gtum po sngon mo/ sngo ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ byang du rdo rje nyi ma ser po ser nag ljang ba/ nub tu rdo rje gtsug tor dmar po dmar nag ljang ba/ lho ru rdo rje 'khyil ba ljang khu ljang dkar ser ba/ mer rdo rje gnod sbyin dud kha/ dud ser ljang ba/ bden bral du rdo rje dus dmar po/ dmar ser ljang ba/ rlung du rdo rje stobs po che nag po nag ser ljang ba/ dbang gdan du rdo rje 'jigs rung sngon po sngo ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum mi g.yo ba/ de rnams phyag dang po gnyis kyi cang te'u dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba dkar po/ dkar nag ljang ba/ phyag dang po gnyis 'khor lo dang dril bu/ 'og tu rdo rje sa log nag po nag ser ljang ba/ phyag dang po gnyis rtse gsum dang dril bu/ khro bo bcu po rnams ni phyogs skyong ba bcu gnon pa/ gtso 'khor thams cad rtsa phyag gnyis kyi rang snang gi rig ma la 'khyud cing*/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis na lcags kyu+u dang zhags pa/ g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ cher khros shing*/ stag lpags kyi sham thams can/ rus pa dang sbrul gyi brgyan cing*/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang*/ mi mgo'i do shal can/ pad nyi la g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyi bzhugs pa'o/ /oṃ sum+bha zhes sogs kyi bka' bgos pas/ khro bo rnams kyi bgegs rnams bkug /spyi bor phur bus btab/ oṃ gha gha sogs/ de rnams tho bas brdungs/ oṃ badz+ra mud+ga ra sogs/ bgegs rnams stong pa nyid du bcom ste de bzhin nyid dang ro gcig tu gyur/

oṃ kha badz+ra ḍh-ika badz+ra hūm̐ ka ra badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa lā na lārga badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ṣ+ṇi ṣa badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kuṇ+ḍa li badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa lā tra badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kā li badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mahā bā la badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bhī ṣa ṇa badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ gtso bo nyid kyi rtsa sngags zhal bzhi pa gang 'grub bzla/ 'dir thun mong ma yin pa'i bsrung 'khor shin tu bsdus pa'i tshul gyi bkod pa yin gyi/ rgyas 'bring sogs bsgom par 'dod na/ khro bo rnam rol du rgyas par bshad zin pa bzhin bsgom par bya'o/ / oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ a ni mi ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ a pra ṇi hi ra dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi bar do'i rnam par shes pa nā da'i rna ma pas nam mkhar gnas/ 'og tu yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dkon mchog zla gam/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du bam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du lam las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ de'i steng du sum̐ las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ de'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo bh+rūm̐ gyi mtshan pa las/ rin po che sna tshogs las gru pa'i gzhal med khang*/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa pha gu dang bre phul dang gser gyi snam bu dang*/ dra phyed dang*/ shar bu dang*/ zla yab dang*/ bzung ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng du ka bas steg pa'i rta babs snam bu bzhi dang bcas pa/ nang gi lha rnams shar dkar/ bya ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser/ dbus sngo ba/ phyi rol mchod pa'i bkod pa thams cad dang bcas shing*/ pad 'dab kyi khor yug gi phyi rol tu/

dur khrod chen po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba dang*/ zhing skyong ba dang/ shing dang*/ me dang*/ chu dang*/ sprin dang*/ ri dang/ mchod rten dang*/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi yongs su gang ba/ phyi rol tu bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang bzhi dkyil gyi dbus su/ rdo rje sems pa'i dkyil 'khor/ shar du rnam par snang mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor/ lho stod du rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dkyil 'khor/ lho smad du snang ba mtha' yas kyi dkyil 'khor/ /byang stod du mi skyod pa'i dkyil 'khor/ byang smad du don yod grub pa'i dkyir 'khor/ thams cad kyang rta babs dang bral ba/ lhag ma gzhal med khang gi mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ nang ka ba brgyad brgyad dang ldan pa/ steng thog mdzes par phug cing*/ dbus rnams phyur bur gyur pa/ dkyil 'khor de rnams kyi dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang 'dab ma brgyad pa'i gdan ni re re/ de rnams kyi lte bar rim pas/ seng khri pad+ma nyi ma/ 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi gdan dang*/ seng khri pad+ma zla ba tshangs pa dang*/ rta'i khri pad+ma nyi ma/ lha'i bu nyi ma dang*/ rma bya'i khri pad+ma nyi ma dbang phyug chen po dang*/ glang po che'i khri pad+ma nyi ma khyab 'jug dang*/ mkha' lding khri pad+ma nyi ma lha'i bu zla ba/ gdan drug car gyi steng du a ā nas/ aṃ a phrag gnyis gnyis yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor drug /ka kha nas/ ha k+ṣa/ ya ra la wa ḍa dha rnams phrag gnyis gnyis yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor drug /de rnams kyi dbus su rim pas/ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ am̐ hriṃ kham̐ ram̐ bam̐ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje dkar po/ 'khor lo/ rin po che/ rdo rje sngon po/ pad+ma/ ral gri rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus shing thim pa las/ rigs drug gi 'khor los bsgyur ba/ yab yum rang rang gi 'khor dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/

gzhal med khang dbus ma'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rang nyid ye shes mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje sems pa sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum chos kyi dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ dkar mo g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ shar lhor mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo/ lho nub tu lā ma ljang khu/ nub byang du khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dmar mo/ byang shar du gzugs can la ser mo/ thams cad kyang g.yas ḍa ma ru dang g.yon thod pa thogs pa/ shar du khaṇ+ḍa ka pa la dang rab tu gtum mo/ byang du mahā kaṃ ka la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ nub tu kaṃ ka la dang 'od ldan la/ lhor mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma ste/ dpa' bo rnams sku mdog sngon po/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rnams dkar mo rdo rje thod khrag rnams pa/ dkyil 'khor shar ma'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du dpal rtag pa sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro dkar po/ 'khor lo dang de yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo/ /'khor lo dang thod khrag 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ shar du su ra bi ri dang brtan pa'i blo can ma/ byang du 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ nub tu rdo rje'i 'od dang lang ka'i dbang phyug ma/ lhor rdo rje sku dang shing grib ma ste dpa' bo rnams sku mdog dkar po/ 'khor lo dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum rnams ser mo 'khor lo dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ dkyil 'khor lho lha ma'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rdo rje nyi ma rin chen mkha' 'gro sku mdog ser po rin po che dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo/ rin po che dang thod khrag 'dzin mas 'khyud pa/ shar du aṃ ku ri dang e ra ba tī/ byang du ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo/ nub tu dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ lhor rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma ste/

dpa' bo rnams ser po rin chen dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rnams ljang khu rin po che dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ dkyil 'khor nub ma'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ pad+ma gar dbang pad+ma mkha' 'gro sku mdog dmar po/ g.yas pad+ma dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu la 'dzin pa yum pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo/ pad+ma dang thod khrag 'dzin mas 'khyud pa/ shar du rab tu bzang po dang sh+yā ba de ni/ byang du rdo rje bzang po dang shin du bzang mo/ nub tu 'jigs byed chen po dang rta sna ma/ lhor mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma ste/ dpa' bo rnams sku mdog dmar po pad+ma dang des mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rnams dkar mo pad+ma dang thod pa 'dzin mas 'khyud pa/ dkyil 'khor nub byang ma'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du dpal he ru ka rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog nag po/ khro bo'i rdo rje dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon po/ khro bo'i rdo rje thod khrag 'dzin mas 'khyud pa/ shar du stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ byang du rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇ+ḍa ro hi/ nub tu rta mgrin dang shau ṇa ni/ lhor nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i cha ma ste/ dpa' bo rnams sku mdog nag po khro bo'i rdo rje dang des mtshan pa'i dil bu 'dzin pa/ yum rnams la ser mo rdo rje dang thod khrag 'dzin ma/ dkyil 'khor byang shar ma'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du dpal rta mchog sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ljang khu/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma ljang ser/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang thod khrag 'dzin mas 'khyud pa/ shar du dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ byang du pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ nub tu rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor lo bsgyur ma/ lhor rdo rje sems pa dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste/

dpa' bo rnams sku mdog ljang khu/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang des mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rnams sngo skya sna tshogs rdo rje dang thod khrag 'dzin ma/ gtso bo bcom ldan drug ni rdo rje'i skyil krung can yum drug ni pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyi yab la 'khril ba phyag g.yon yab la 'khyud pa/ g.yas rdo rje sdigs mdzub dang bcas phyag mtshan rnams 'phyar ba'o/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi po rnams g.yas brkyangs pas bzhengs shing*/ dpa' mo rnams g.yon brkyang gi 'khyud pa/ phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo khwa gdong ma sngon po/ g.yas lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ byang sgo 'ug gdong ma ljang khu g.yas zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nub skor khyi gdong ma dmar mo g.yas lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo g.yas dril bu 'dzin pa/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ g.yas me long 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya ma g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ g.yas pas pi wang 'dzin pa/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba dri chab kyi dung chos 'dzin pa/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms pa g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ g.yas ro drug gis gang ba'i snod 'dzin pa/ de ltar sgo mtshams ma brgyad ni/ drag mo'i tshul can/ ma mo bcu gnyis po thams cad kyang phyag g.yon na thod pa dang*/ grub mo g.yon par kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ ro'i gdan la g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyis gnas pa/ yab thams cad ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pa dang/ phyag rgya drug dang mgo bo'i 'phreng ba can/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ 'khyud pa'i phyag rgyas yum dang sbyor ba/ lha mo thams cad skra grol ba phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thams cad yang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor drug car gyi pad+ma'i mtshams kyis 'dab ma bzhi la/ ka pā la bdud rtsi lngas gang ba re re'o/

/oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥsarba bi ra yo gi ni kā ya waka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥbadz+ra shud+dho3haṃ/ lha thams cad kyi snying gar oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems pa nas/ phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo

zhes pa'i bar go cha gnyis kyi brgyas btab/ spro na gong du bshad pa'i phung khams kyi lha bcu bdun po yang bskyed la/ bsdu na/ gzugs kyi phung po la ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ / zhes sogs dag pa dran par bya/ lha thams cad kyi dpra bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ḥ 'khor los sgyur ba drug gi thugs kar rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar ti nge 'dzin sems dpa' rim pas/ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ am̐ hrīṃ hūm̐ kham̐/ thugs ka'i 'od zer ye shes kyi 'khor lo dbang gi lha mchod pa'i lha mo dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ phaiṃ/ oṃ ni shir badz+ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa nas/ oṃ dharma dha tu badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyi bar gyis mchod/ dza ཿ hūṃ baṃ ho ཿ oṃ yo ga shud+dha ཿ sarba dharma ཿ yo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes dbang gi lha rnams la gsol ba btab pas/ gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma kun dang*/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon po yis/ /brtse nas bdag la dbangabaskur stsol/ / zhes kyang gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pa/ /rinachen dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /zhes gsungs zhing bum pa bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems pa la sogs pa rigs lnga la/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro nyid la ye shes mkha' 'gro dang*/ 'khor rnams la rang rang gi gtso bo dang*/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad la rdo rje sems pas dbu rgyan/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams gzhan dang mtshungs la/ rdo rje 'chang dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /dzā lan+dha rar nag po spyod pa dang*/ /dge mgon ti li na ro ma ṇi ka /chos dbang bzod pa yab sras rnam pa gsum/ /shāka rdor sangs rgyas 'bum dang lo mchog pa/ /grags chen 'phags 'od bu ston byang rtse dang*/

/grags rgyal chos rgyal dpal 'byor bzang po dang*/ /mthu stobs rab brtan nam mkha' lhun grub dang*/ / 'jam dbyangs rgyan mtshan rtsa ba'i bla ma mchod/ / ces 'don pa spo/ bstod pa ni/ yab yum gyi rkang brgyad de nyid lnga pas bstod/ lus dang tshor ba dang ches pa nas/ gshin rje 'joms ma'o/ /phung po drug rnam par dag ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa drug khams drug rnam par dag pa ni rdo rje btsun mo drug go /dkyil 'khor drug ni sa drug ste/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i gnas ni sa lhag ma bzhi'o/ / bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ shrī mahā su kha badz+ra satwa ḍā ki nī dzā la saṃ bha raṃ/ hūm̐ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ shrī bud+dhā ḍā ki a la la la bh+rūm̐ āḥ oṃ ḍā ki nī dzā la saṃ bha raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī ran+ta ḍā ki tra ཾ aḥ oṃ ḍā ki nī dzā la saṃ bha raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī pad+ma ḍā ki hriḥ.aḥ oṃ ḍā ki nī dzā la saṃ bha raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ḍā ki aḥ hūm̐ phaṭa ḍā ki nī dzā la saṃ bha raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ shrī bi shwā ḍā ki ho ཿ kha ཾ āḥ hūm̐ ḍā ki nī dzā la saṃ bha raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ 'khor gyi sngags ni/ oṃ khaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa nas/ oṃ yaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa kyi bar/ rang ming gi dang po'i yi ge nyid sngags kyi ngo bor gsungs so/ /thun bsdu bar 'dod pa'i tshe/ sems can thams cad la byang chub kyi sems kyi dbang bskur ba sogs byas nas/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i tshul gzhan rnams dang mtshungs pa las/ thun mtshams la/ 'jug pa'i tshe/ rdo rje sems dpa' phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal bya'o/ / gtor ma'i cho ga ni/ dril bu'i zhabs lugs kyi man ngag ltar bya ba las/ 'dod don gsol btab kyi rjes su/ dpyid kyi rgyal po'i glu dbyangs nges par brjod pa nyid yin no/ /shin tu zab cing gsang ba ste/ /nges par brjod pa'i rgyud rgyal las/ /kun gyi rigs bsdus dkyil 'khor mchog

/dkyil 'khor gtso bor bsngags pa ste/ /'di yi sgrub thabs byas pa yin/ /zhes pa 'khor lo sgyur drug gi sgrub thabs phun tshogs thams cad bskyed pa'i gzhi zhes bya ba/ rgyud kyi dgongs pa ltar/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnal 'byor pa tā ra nā tha'am/ kun dga' snying por 'bod pas rang lo sum cu pa la nye bar sbyar ba'o// //bkra shis// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/'khor lo sgyur drug gi sgrub thabs phun tshogs thams cad bskyed pa'i gzhi zhes bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 344 -- PAGE 343 -- PAGE 333 -
